description.value: The Candy Jar is a locally owned Tofino shop operating since 2010 that blends a retro candy store and Island Farms ice cream parlour with a bike and scooter rental service. Cyclists and visitors can rent cruiser bikes, electric bikes, or electric scooters to explore the Tofino-Ucluelet Multi-Use Trail, with suggested routes ranging from a short 8 km return to Tacofino all the way to an 80 km return trip to Ucluelet. It is a convenient one-stop for a touring cyclist wanting a sweet treat and a rental for a day ride.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 60m; stands (6 spaces) at 75m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for https://thecandyjartofino.com/ clearly identifies the business as 'The Candy Jar,' a candy/gift/ice cream shop at 366 Campbell St, Tofino, that also rents Cruiser Bikes, Electric Bikes, and Electric Scooters — confirmed on the /bike-rentals subpage. The OSM name 'Tuff City Scooter Rentals' does not match the website name and is flagged as a concern. No evidence of repair services, pumps, or any mechanical support appears anywhere on the website; this is a rental-only operation from a retail shop.
